term_sheet_text:
TERM SHEET (FICTIONAL DEMO DOCUMENT, NOT AN OFFER)
Issuer: Nusa Data Labs. Lead investor: Garuda Seed Partners.
Investment: USD 2,000,000 for Series A preferred shares.
Pre-money valuation: USD 8,000,000, fully diluted, including an option pool equal to 12% of the post-money capitalisation (the pool increase comes out of the pre-money).
Liquidation preference: 1x, non-participating.
Board: 2 founder seats, 1 investor seat.
Anti-dilution: broad-based weighted average.
Pro rata rights for the investor in the next round.
This term sheet expires 72 hours after it is sent.
